items.title: Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 1997
items.q: I was with the Charlie Ventura band in ‘49.

ctx.x: We should explain your nickname. Because you share it with another pretty famous musician.

Okay. I was with the Charlie Ventura band in ‘49. And there was an alto player who is in this picture, Boots Mussulli. He was with that band and I think I’d just come back from Europe and I had this black winter coat, a wool coat, with a high collar, and I wore a black beret and I had a very pencil thin mustache. And Boots says, “Man you look like a Count.” So he started calling me “Count.” And he was the only one at that time. And then all of a sudden Charlie Ventura started calling me Count and then when I left…
